einzeiler: The history of the Turtle, the revolutionary American submarine that attacked the British.
kurzfassung: In 1776, inventor David Bushnell created the Turtle, an early one-man submarine designed to attach explosives to British ships in New York Harbor. Piloted by Sergeant Ezra Lee, the secret mission ultimately failed due to strong tides, exhaustion, and drilling difficulties. Despite this, the vessel frightened the British and marked a notable early milestone in submarine warfare.
stichpunkte: David Bushnell developed a small wooden submarine named the Turtle to attack the British Navy in New York Harbor.
The vessel was propelled by hand cranks and foot treadles, operating near the surface with air supplied by snorkels.
Foxfire glowing fungus was used to illuminate the compass and barometer without consuming the cabin's limited oxygen.
The submarine towed a 150-pound gunpowder mine with a screw mechanism and a timing device.
Original pilot Ezra Bushnell fell ill with typhus, prompting the recruitment and training of Sergeant Ezra Lee.
On September 6, 1776, Lee launched the attack but struggled against an outgoing tide and exhaustion.
Lee failed to drill into the British flagship Eagle and released the explosive mine during his escape to deter pursuers.
The British eventually sank the transport vessel carrying the Turtle after three failed attempts, ending the project.

clips.text: An explanation of how glowing wood fungus served as a practical light source for navigation instruments underwater without depleting the cabin air.
Details regarding the heavy gunpowder mine towed by the submarine, equipped with a screw attachment and a gun-fired timing mechanism.
The original pilot fell seriously ill with suspected typhus just as the mission was set to begin, forcing a last-minute replacement.

beschreibung:
On September 6, 1776, the Continental Army deployed a submarine against the British fleet in New York.

For more on this, go to Episode 104 of the American Revolution Podcast at https://blog.amrevpodcast.com/2019/07/episode-104-submarine-warfare.html
